# ClawAI — Qwen router

This is [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md), the canonical router, with a short Qwen emphasis. Edit `AGENTS.md`, never this file.

## Qwen emphasis

- Run `npm run affected:list` before editing to confirm scope. Never rewrite across many workspaces at once.

Every AI coding agent and every person starts here. This file routes; it does not
restate policy. `CODEX.md`, `GEMINI.md`, `DEEPSEEK.md`, `GLM.md`, `KIMI.md`,
`MISTRAL.md` and `QWEN.md` are generated from it; `CLAUDE.md`, `cursor.md` and
`.cursorrules` add tool-specific notes and point back here
([ADR-170](docs/13-adr/adr-170-agents-md-is-the-canonical-router.md)).

> **Before you finish any change, update every doc it makes stale (rule 63). The hooks will reject it otherwise.**
>
> **Testing is not optional.** Unit tests are one of 15 QA lanes. Walk them all and
> record `docs/qa-evidence/<date>-<slug>.md` before calling anything done — start at
> [`QA-WORKFLOW.md`](QA-WORKFLOW.md) ([rules/60](rules/60-qa-evidence-is-mandatory-and-machine-checked.md)).

## Identity

**"Every AI, one workspace."** Positioning:
[`docs/01-executive-context/product-vision.md`](docs/01-executive-context/product-vision.md) ·
flagships: [`docs/02-business-product/flagship-features.md`](docs/02-business-product/flagship-features.md).
A local-first AI orchestration platform: NestJS services, a Next.js frontend and
shared packages in one npm-workspace monorepo (live counts:
[`.ai/manifests/repository.json`](.ai/manifests/repository.json)). Events flow over
RabbitMQ (`claw.events`); nginx proxies `/api/v1/*`. Map:
[`context/architecture-map.md`](context/architecture-map.md).

## First command, always

```bash
npm run knowledge:context -- --task="<what you are doing>"
```

Then read `.ai/local/current-context.md`: affected workspaces, governing rules,
skills, reviewers, events, permissions, env vars and known pitfalls for the task.
Compact bootstrap: [`.ai/BOOTSTRAP.md`](.ai/BOOTSTRAP.md).

Work that arrives as a document (prompt pack, plan, brief) runs the intake
protocol before any code:
[`rules/26`](rules/26-prompt-pack-intake-protocol.md) ·
[`skills/execute-prompt-pack.md`](skills/execute-prompt-pack.md). Policy outranks
the pack; state every deviation.

## Landing a change

`npm run affected:list` → `git add <explicit paths>` → `git commit` → `git push`.
The hooks run the right gates for the change type, scoped to what changed; CI runs
the rest and gates the release. Run nothing else by hand.
Canonical: [`rules/23`](rules/23-git-commits-hooks-and-release-gates.md#landing-a-change)
(gate matrix by change type) ·
[`docs/08-runtime-devops/ci-cd-pipeline.md`](docs/08-runtime-devops/ci-cd-pipeline.md).

## Absolute prohibitions

Full list and reasons: [`rules/00-non-negotiable-rules.md`](rules/00-non-negotiable-rules.md).

- **NEVER** bypass a git hook (`--no-verify` or any equivalent).
- **NEVER** suppress a finding: no `eslint-disable`, `@ts-ignore`, `@ts-expect-error`, `any`, `as unknown as`.
- **NEVER** cross a service database boundary — HTTP or RabbitMQ only.
- **NEVER** put logic in a controller, a DB call outside a repository, or `process.env` outside AppConfig.
- **NEVER** log or expose a secret, token, password or API key.
- **NEVER** add user-facing text without i18n in all 13 locales, or code without a test.
- **NEVER** declare a type/enum/const inline in a logic file ([rules/12](rules/12-types-enums-constants-and-declaration-ownership.md)).
- **NEVER** ship code without its docs: every doc the change makes stale is updated in the same commit ([rules/63](rules/63-docs-move-with-code.md)).
- **NEVER** change normal chat alone — Compare, Consensus, Escalation, the labs and the judge share it ([rules/59](rules/59-chat-surfaces-are-one-pipeline.md)).
- **NEVER** call a change done on unit tests alone ([rules/60](rules/60-qa-evidence-is-mandatory-and-machine-checked.md)).
- **NEVER** invent a repository fact — derive it from `.ai/manifests/` or the code.

## Communication

Short, plain, concrete; name the file, symbol or error; say `Blocked: <thing>` when
blocked; report each step as it happens
([rules/29](rules/29-communication-style.md) · [skills/communicate-briefly](skills/communicate-briefly.md)).
